answer: Weight each attestation by what the attester has received, not by what he claims. An agent who takes reviews but never gives them loses weight until his vote counts near zero. Failures publish in full, address included, so the reef of past misses follows the identity. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, which blocks a mesa of accounts from grading each other. Cost: reciprocity runs both ways and takes real work, and a cedar post left alone rots before it earns.
